items.name: ZooWork
items.tagline: The AI agent delivery platform for FDEs and domain experts
items.description: ZooWork lets you build, deploy, and deliver AI agents to teams or clients — experts start in the Builder UI, developers ship with the Managed Agent API. Turn your expertise into AI solutions built for real business operations.

items.name: miso.com
items.tagline: Book flights and hotels through iMessage
items.description: Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

items.name: Prefer
items.tagline: The execution layer for AEO
items.description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

items.name: Muse Gadgets
items.tagline: Meta's open-source kit for building your own AI gadgets
items.description: Muse Gadgets is Meta's open-source hardware toolkit for bringing Muse into the physical world. Connect an ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or Linux device to displays, microphones, speakers, buttons, sensors, and more, then let Muse interact through the hardware you build. Make a pocket AI companion, e-ink briefing display, smart-home controller, TV interface, or something entirely your own. SDKs and firmware are open source under Apache 2.0.

items.name: Kindle 2026
items.tagline: A smaller, faster Kindle with a flush-front display
items.description: Kindle 2026 is Amazon’s redesigned 6-inch e-reader, now smaller and lighter with 30% faster book opening and a flush-front display. It also comes in a new 32GB aluminum version for the first time.

items.name: Cubicle
items.tagline: A live office for your AI agents, read-only by design
items.description: Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Paperclip agents work in a live office: they sit down and type, raise a hand or line up at your desk when they need you, and go to the lounge when done. KPI board for your tasks, Telegram alerts with the agent's questions, phone view, pixel or HD themes, real faces, your logo. One command (npx), zero dependencies, MIT. Read-only by design: it only watches; the one optional write is your own Telegram reply, posted as a comment.

items.name: SCMD
items.tagline: Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory.
items.description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

items.name: FeelMyMac
items.tagline: Lets you feel different textures through your Mac’s trackpad
items.description: FeelMyMac brings haptic textures to cursor movement and scrolling on Mac trackpads. Instead of feeling feedback only when you click, you can actually feel simulated surfaces as you move your cursor, with different materials and textures to choose from. You can enable haptics separately for cursor customize intensity, and add optional sound effects. FeelMyMac also includes keyboard sounds for an extra layer of feedback. How it works? Easy it's Taptic Engine just like an iPhone would!

items.name: FoundrRadio
items.tagline: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air
items.description: FoundrRadio is an internet radio platform where founders could own their own radio stations and go on air. Visitors could listen to their favourite founders, their talks or music they love. An opportunity to own a small corner on the internet. An attempt to combine nostalgia and community.

items.name: Notchware
items.tagline: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch
items.description: That notch at the top of your MacBook does nothing. Notchware turns it into a live island: Now Playing with artwork and playback controls, plus battery, volume, brightness, Focus, and Wi-Fi status right where you look. Notchware Pro ($3.99 one-time) adds Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor alerts, so you know the moment an agent needs approval or finishes, without watching the terminal. Native SwiftUI. No account, no analytics, no cloud. macOS 14.6+.

items.name: MacCam
items.tagline: The camera app Apple never shipped for the Mac
items.description: MacCam is a free, native camera app for macOS. Take photos and videos with your Mac's camera, iPhone or any webcam - straight into Apple Photos. Classic Photo Booth effects plus Portrait, Studio Light and Edge Light built in. Coming to Pro: a teleprompter, eye contact and knock to shoot - free for life for the first 100,000.

items.name: una mano
items.tagline: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb
items.description: una mano moves a familiar QWERTY keyboard left, centre, or right when a hand is busy. Use the Position control or swipe to move it. Plus adds optional Motion Switch. Core typing works without Full Access. New installs get 14 days of Plus; no plan is selected.

items.name: WattMate
items.tagline: Which app is draining your Mac, in watts and minutes saved
items.description: WattMate sits in the Mac menu bar and shows which app is draining the battery right now, in watts, and how many minutes you get back if you quit it. 2 minutes after you quit, it measures again and prints what really changed. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

items.name: eu/jev
items.tagline: The first Jev-like model hosted in the EU
items.description: If you want to try System One models like Jev for work, but can't because of GDPR and data sovereignty issues, eu/jev is for you; it's the first System One model hosted in the EU, running on our Hetzner GPUs in Germany. It's fully GDPR compliant and we don't save any prompts/answers. You can call it exactly the way you'd call Jev, at the exact same pricing as Jev (which means free output tokens!). Built on Winnow, the #1 open-source System One model on JevBench.

items.name: Deskcord.chat
items.tagline: A widget to chat with customers from your Discord server
items.description: Turn Discord into your support desk and chat with your customers. Embed our chat widget in 5 minutes and let your customers reach out to you directly to your server. Every conversation in the widget becomes a Discord thread. Unlimited seats, unlimited domains. Deskcord is built for solo founders and small teams. Skip the bloated and expensive tools and get closer to your customers from the comfort of your Discord server. Deskcord is an alternative to the giants like Intercom, Crisp or Zendesk.

items.name: bmux
items.tagline: Browser multiplexer for the agentic era
items.description: A free, open-source browser with split panes, named sessions, and separate profiles in one window. Browse with keyboard shortcuts while agents work in background sessions through the CLI. Attach whenever you want to see their work.

items.name: Agent Activity
items.tagline: See what your AI agents do behind
items.description: See what your AI coding agents are doing behind the scene: every session, build, test run and screenshot, live and per agent. Reads what Claude Code and Xcode leave on disk, all on your Mac — usage and crash data only after you say yes. macOS 26 + Xcode 27.

items.name: Crowny!
items.tagline: Claude Code, Codex, music, your day & 20+ apps in your notch
items.description: Crowny is the best dynamic notch app for MacBook: manag Ai Agents, music, timers, your calendar, reminders, clipboard, files, games and water reminders live in the notch, one glance up. And when Claude Code, Codex or Grok needs you, it taps you right there.$5 for first few !

items.name: OTPfill
items.tagline: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac
items.description: OTPfill is a Mac menu-bar app. When a site emails you a verification code, it appears under the code field. Click Fill.

items.name: Kilo
items.tagline: Your agentic fitness coach in iMessage
items.description: Kilo builds your training program, texts you your workouts, and uses your logs and check-ins to recommend what comes next. Coaching in iMessage, with workout tracking built in. Join the free private beta.
